paper_claims.claim: Motus2 Midtrain-SFT achieves an 84% average success rate across 5 challenging real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, while pi0.5 and pure video SFT score 0%.
Action-first factorization factorizes the joint distribution into policy, action-conditioned visual simulation, and task evaluation.
DiffusionNFT optimizes the policy using relative progress value guidance without manual reward engineering.
MBRL with Best-of-N planning raises average performance from 65.0% to 75.0% on real robot tasks.
Global autoregression achieves 57.5% success rate on long-horizon memory tasks, outperforming hybrid memory (25.0%).
Tactile expert provides a +12.5% gain on contact-critical tasks (72.5% vs 60.0%).
